claim: Hofmann et al. state that their frictional-contact force, with its thermodynamically consistent noise, was merged into HOOMD-blue and is documented in HOOMD-blue version 6.1.0 as the module hoomd.md.pair.friction.
validity_conditions: A STATEMENT ABOUT SOFTWARE BY THE AUTHORS, as of the article's publication (online 21 April 2026). It names version 6.1.0 and says nothing about later releases. This repository pins HOOMD-blue 7.2.0; whether the module is present and unchanged there is not asserted by this entry and has to be checked against that release before a plan relies on it. The paper's MIPS results were not run in HOOMD but in LAMMPS.
